pages.title: Pigment Jars
pages.text: If you have Fast Recolouring enabled, you can obtain recolours of flowers simply by right-clicking on them with a Pigment Jar of your desired colour. This also acts as a way of duplicating flowers.

pages.title: Botany Tables
pages.text: If Fast Recolouring is off, then you'll have to use the $(l:botany_table)Botany Table$(/l) to obtain recoloured flowers. You can breed recoloured flowers using two Pollen Vials of the same type, and a Pigment Jar of the colour you want the flower to be.
